pages.text_en: The harvest is a bust again, Mikey. We worked all day and only grew one potato. Being a newbie is so hard, my stomach's drumming. Here ye, whoever can pull this sword, as foretold, shall become our new king. A magic sword? No one's ever pulled it out.

sentences.text_en: The harvest is a bust again, Mikey.
We worked all day and only grew one potato.
Being a newbie is so hard, my stomach's drumming.
Here ye, whoever can pull this sword,
as foretold, shall become our new king.
A magic sword?
No one's ever pulled it out.

pages.text_en: Hey, it won't budge. Must be glued with super glue. Shh, move along, weakling. Oh my gosh, JJ, you're the king.

sentences.text_en: Hey, it won't budge.
Must be glued with super glue.
Shh, move along, weakling.
Oh my gosh, JJ, you're the king.

pages.text_en: Welcome to our new home, Mikey. It's huge. I might get lost on the way to the bathroom. First royal duty, inspect the entire castle. Second duty: feast.

sentences.text_en: Welcome to our new home, Mikey.
It's huge. I might get lost on the way to the bathroom.
First royal duty, inspect the entire castle.
Second duty: feast.

pages.text_en: Legend says the royal treasure lies behind this door. I smell gold, or just moldy rags. Whoa, a lava moat. Careful, don't roast your new pants. Piece of cake, watch my nimble hops.

sentences.text_en: Legend says the royal treasure lies behind this door.
I smell gold, or just moldy rags.
Whoa, a lava moat.
Careful, don't roast your new pants.
Piece of cake, watch my nimble hops.

pages.text_en: We're rich, I'm buying a million pizzas. Enough wealth for the entire village for a lifetime. Look, these are the castle's defense systems. Sweet, hope we never need them.

sentences.text_en: We're rich, I'm buying a million pizzas.
Enough wealth for the entire village for a lifetime.
Look, these are the castle's defense systems.
Sweet, hope we never need them.

pages.text_en: Mmm, being royal is the best. Slow down, leave some for the guards. Alarm, something's breaching the castle. Can't it wait until dessert?

sentences.text_en: Mmm, being royal is the best.
Slow down, leave some for the guards.

Can't it wait until dessert?

pages.text_en: With our skeleton legion, they're after the throne. Hundreds of them, we're surrounded. Move, haul the turret cannons from the vault. Roger, defense mode on.

sentences.text_en: With our skeleton legion, they're after the throne.
Hundreds of them, we're surrounded.
Move, haul the turret cannons from the vault.
Roger, defense mode on.

pages.text_en: Set the line here, build a wall of death. Taste the arrow rain, boneheads. It's working, they can't break through the arrow wall.

sentences.text_en: Set the line here, build a wall of death.
Taste the arrow rain, boneheads.
It's working, they can't break through the arrow wall.

pages.text_en: Back up, Mikey, this big guy is mine. For the kingdom. Epic, JJ.

sentences.text_en: Back up, Mikey, this big guy is mine.
For the kingdom.
Epic, JJ.

pages.text_en: We did it, the kingdom stands. You're a great king, JJ, you really fight for us. Being king is exhausting. Wake me for breakfast.
